# Content skills

This folder defines the conventions used when editing docs and instructions in this repository.

## Principles

- Match existing documentation tone and structure.
- Keep pages aligned with the current VitePress navigation schema.
- Update generated sidebars when adding or renaming docs.
- Prefer repo-specific wording over generic development guidance.

## Example

When adding a new documentation page, confirm whether it needs an entry in `.vitepress/data/components.ts` or `.vitepress/data/guides.ts`.
